conclusion: With only the 40-day arm's steps changed (1500 -> 6000, 192,000 sample exposures = 0.60 epochs of the 40-day pool), the seed-mean paired daily all-eight-time RankIC difference against the retained 10-day/1500 reference was +0.020429 against the unchanged predeclared floor of 0.011647; per window research_a: +0.040495, research_b: +0.000362. The descriptive step contrast against the archived 40-day/1500 arm was +0.007701 (research_a: +0.004723, research_b: +0.010680). The candidate fails the predeclared gates worst_day_guardrail, so the 10-day reference is retained. Per preregistration the round ends here: no other step count was searched, and this is not evidence that more history is uninformative.
